name: AI Wiki File Management
description: Manages Ryan's canonical AI Wiki safely, including naming, staging, promotion, MCP/Hermes skill scanning, project overlays, registry maintenance, and PowerShell-first verification.
write_policy: Prefer staging generated durable content into 07_inbound/proposed. Reviewed installers may update 04_skills, skills/projects, and 03_indexes with backups.
